# AqNoorLabs

AqNoorLabs is a custom software development agency specializing in building websites, web applications, mobile apps, desktop software, and AI automation solutions for businesses, particularly D2C brands, hospitality, and retail merchants in India.

## Key Services

- **Website Development**: Modern, high-performance, and SEO-friendly marketing websites.
- **Web Applications**: Scalable SaaS platforms and custom web portals.
- **Mobile Applications**: Android and iOS apps with smooth native user experiences.
- **Desktop Software**: Offline-first, fast desktop applications.
- **AI & Automation**: n8n workflows, WhatsApp business APIs, and AI chatbot integrations.

## Main Projects

- **MyMedicare** (Pharmacy POS & Inventory Platform): A cloud-based pharmacy billing, inventory, and management system.
  - URL: https://mymedicare.aqnoorlabs.online/
  - Category: Pharmacy POS / Web Application
- **Biznexis** (All-in-One E-commerce & Seller Utility): A client-side optimized utility platform for Shopify, Amazon, and Meesho merchants to automate invoice parsing, barcode sheets, GST/DTC margin calculations, site performance audits, resume analysis, and SEO ad copies.
  - URL: https://biznexis.aqnoorlabs.online/
  - Category: Web Application / E-commerce Utility
- **Hotel Diamond** (Hotel POS & QR Table Booking): A counter billing, table booking, and restaurant management POS system featuring QR code scanning and an AI chatbot.
  - URL: https://hoteldiamond.aqnoorlabs.online/
  - Category: Web Application / Hospitality POS
- **Aura Fintech Mobile App**: A personal expense tracker with zero-sync delays.
- **Chronos Developer CLI**: Server and database health monitoring dashboard.
- **NexusAI Support Assistant**: 24/7 customer support chatbot reducing response times.
- **PulseOps Cloud Monitor**: DevOps server monitoring and cost optimization tool.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Node.js, Spring Boot, Express
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite
- **DevOps**: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, GitHub
- **Automation**: n8n, OpenAI API, WhatsApp Business API
